author: Th3picJG
body:
My IGN is Th3picJG and I was banned around 5 months ago (i think). I was banned because of fly hacking however i have have realized that it was a stupid thing to do because i enjoy the server so much.
I think I should be unbanned from the server because I promise to not hack again, I will play on the server frequently and I just love the server so much. I hope you consider my appeal because all I have wanted to do for the past 5 months is play on the serer.
